title: Context-intelligence pipeline (census/index, bounded context compiler, ontology, measurement) - units A1/A2/B/C/D/E/F
applicability_note: Rows bind the seven initiative ledger tasks M0-T063 (A1), M0-T064 (A2), M0-T065 (B), M0-T066 (C), M0-T067 (D), M0-T068 (E), M0-T069 (F) via applicability.task_ids. D-013-BOOTSTRAP is a NON-LEDGER governance sentinel (D-012-VALIDATION precedent) for the owner's bootstrap-only session duties; sentinel rows are verified at directive verification, never inside a ledger task's accept() set. applicability.paths is deliberately empty so D-013 never forces unrelated tasks into citation; binding is by task id only. Unit tasks cite D-013:ALL at claim; the resolver derives each task's applicable subset. scope.task_types carries 'governance' (D-012 precedent) because the initiative's units edit control-plane files (their packets and reports) under this directive's authority, satisfying the s19/D-001-R118 governance-path claim guard for the scoped task_ids.

owner_approval.decision: Owner typed the OWNER AUTHORIZATION message of 2026-08-18 (source-002) authorizing the initiative after the completed Codex go-live runway, approving the A1/A2 split, fixing decisions 1-10, and restricting this first session to bootstrap-only ending at READY_FOR_SUPERVISOR_START.
